lines.text: Doormats everywhere are about to have a very long day.
Rain is just snow that stopped trying.
Snow is lovely for about an hour. Then it's a parking problem.
lines.was: Snow is lovely for about an hour. After that, it's a parking problem.

lines.text: Every dad on the block is about to become a road-salt expert.
'Rain before seven, clear by eleven.' Close enough for folklore.
lines.was: 'Rain before seven, clear by eleven.' Close enough, for folklore.

lines.text: For once I can say 'it'll pass' and mean it.
Later someone out there will say 'oh, that's nice' out loud. To nobody.
An app needs a whole graph for this. I just draw less clothing.
Weather this dependable could sell life insurance.
I could do this forecast in sleep mode. I do most things in sleep mode.
Checking three apps and believing the nicest isn't forecasting. It's swiping right.
